description: This file defines a 'TopNav' component for a frontend application using the Lightning.js framework. It includes UI elements like a title and a button to create a new note, and interacts with a store module to add notes.

classes.name: TopNav
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing the top navigation bar with a title and 'New Note' button.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new note by calling store.addNote() and potentially updates the route, though route update is currently commented out.
